title: The Brass Seam
subtitle: A Ledger of Broken Vessels
tagline: The dead are not gone; they are only unpaid.
cover_motif: A clay vessel cracked from lip to foot, drawn shut by three brass staples, with a thin blade of light escaping the seam. Tooled in gold on dark leather: the pot, the staple, the wound that holds.
genre_notes: Dark literary isekai; craft-magic; slow-burn mystery; an anti-chosen-one saga.
